title: Composition and children: Use children for reusable containment without coupling the panel to its contents
description: Learn composition and children with a React 19 model, TypeScript starter and solution, testable edge cases, a bug hunt and offline verification.
objectives: Explain the composition and children contract and why it matters
Repair a deliberately broken react-children example
Verify the expected result and a failure or edge case with local tests
rubric: I can explain composition and children without confusing a render model with mounted browser behavior.
I can repair the starter for 06.01.03, compare with the instructor solution and explain why the test fails before the repair.
I can verify representative and edge-case behavior locally and name at least one additional interaction test needed.
